variants.name: A 潮蚀幽印
variants.text: STYLE A: abyssal pigment and corroded sea-green ritual impressions. Match the reference world's painterly cellular/impasto material: interlocked mottled moss/teal pigment facets, inky broken contours, tiny yellow-green mineral highlights, deep blue-black voids. The sigils have broad solid irregular painted bodies, not stone sculptures. A few edges breathe dull turquoise phosphorescence, most remain matte and dimensional through pigment layering. The central voids feel as though something watches from behind them. Controlled two-value structure; no uniform haze.

variants.name: B 烬骨秘篆
variants.text: STYLE B: prehuman ritual brands in bone-ochre ash and dried cinnabar. Dense matte antique bone pigment and smoky bronze-gold flecks form the thick uneven rune strokes; charred wine-black recesses and a tiny amount of old vermilion bind the symbols. Painterly old print with torn stencil edges and actual granular gouache deposits. Strong silhouettes, dark inner voids, asymmetry and broad broken masses. Not woodcut hatching, not line engraving, not parchment background, not ornate precious metal. Scarred ritual mark seen on a darkened occult card.

variants.name: C 梦魇残章
variants.text: STYLE C: dream-poison ink marks in tarnished silver-lavender and midnight indigo. Broad irregular pale-lilac/ashen pigment strokes with dark purple bloodlike pooling, fractured soft-edged dissolves and a few sharp near-white slivers. The sigils are painted absences and dense fluid stains, with layered brush clumps like an old gouache horror painting. Distinct memorable shapes with convincing substance; no regular polygons, no hard cast shadows or floor, no tiny statue. Calm restrained edge light, never bright neon. Haunting alien calligraphy.

corePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustration sprite atlas for a Chinese Cthulhu card game. Create a HIGH QUALITY 2048 by 3072 portrait image, exactly 4 columns by 6 rows of 24 equally sized SQUARE sprite cells (each nominally 512 square), no gaps, no borders, no headings or text. Uniform almost-black matte ground across the entire sheet. Each separate symbol occupies 65-72% of its own cell, centered, with at least 14% dark safe margin on every side. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Do not draw the grid. This image will be sampled into individual game cards, not displayed as a poster.
Reference images are solely palette/material/brushwork and horror atmosphere references; do not draw planets, people or buildings from them.
Critical art direction: supernatural POWERS and ritual ACTIVITIES are abstract occult SIGILS and RUNES, NOT small illustrative scenes, NOT human figures, NOT realistic ears/hands/faces, NOT wireframes, NOT thin geometric outlines, NOT technical diagrams. Bold filled organic brush-mass symbols with purposeful negative spaces and genuine tactile painterly material, simple enough to recognize at 100 pixels but rich at 512. Each symbol has a distinct outer silhouette and balance. Invented prehuman sacred writing, not existing religious symbols. No readable lettering, pseudo-writing around the outside, labels, circular medallion frames, gilded card frames, UI, 3D objects or model render. No laser neon. Sparse textured marks and restrained bloom only where style calls for them. Painterly cutout graphic art, not polished vector iconography.
